required_inputs: group Bloomberg SPX Index PX_LAST close history
qualified latest close and timing evidence
training_rule: Expanding mature prefix of the original 453 eligible matched weekly origins; keep the existing warmup and May 2020 conflict mask. No added training origins, no tuning, no old 2026 holdout use.
missing_behaviour: Stop on missing or unqualified data, missing features, conflicts, solver failure or verification failure. A fallback model requires a new signed selection bound to the approved fallback and an explicit reason.

source_policy.fallback_rule: Yahoo corroboration requires an explicit signed reason and evidence that FRED is unavailable or stale. A confirmed disagreement stops the run. The primary workbook is never replaced or patched.

reproducibility: Pinned source and calendar SHA-256, dependency versions, single-thread execution, training and normalized input hashes; independent scalar verification at 1e-8 index points and offline replay.

BLEND_VOL_LAD.training_target: Simple percentage return to next Friday cash close
BLEND_VOL_LAD.features: mom20, rv20 and three train-only Spearman-screened price terms from the original 134-candidate universe; redundancy threshold 0.95

HISTORICAL_MEDIAN.training_target: Log gross return to next Friday cash close

marking_reference: Official S&P Dow Jones Indices S&P 500 price-index close
